card.name: Calling for emergency help
card.fires_on: The verb call or calling (and the word for after call) when patients are told to summon emergency help, such as 911 or emergency medical support. It appears in anaphylaxis and opioid overdose counseling.

modes.label: The call for emergency support
modes.description: The word for right after call, in instructions to call for emergency medical support after epinephrine use.

modes.description: The word calling after the importance of, in advice to get emergency help for overdose.
